requirements.physical_controls: Preserve physical control where confirmed by device behavior
requirements.connection_precondition: Operator confirms the belt is stopped before connection; do not send a stop command to satisfy this precondition.
requirements.reconnection_while_running: Unverified. Do not assume a fresh app session can initialize while the belt is moving.

evidence.physical_controls_after_full_official_ap: User confirms all physical buttons work.
evidence.official_app_connection_while_running: User reports iConsole+ cannot connect once a workout has started and speed is already nonzero. This is an operator report, not a packet-level determination of which connection stage fails.
evidence.failed_pc_test_belt_state: Not recorded. Earlier Windows instructions said the treadmill could remain stopped; they did not require or establish a stopped belt.
evidence.stopped_ui_connection_result: Original app Connected successfully; 31 B2 frames at zero; no workout/motor controls clicked; later disconnect observed, cause not established.
evidence.official_workout_control_prompt: Observed in UI: Please control your movement through your console.

control_verification.start: Two full traces show unsolicited B5/02 preceding app A5/02 and running B2 telemetry. Exact operator START action not marked; do not implement automatic key forwarding or claim standalone app START.
control_verification.stop: New physical STOP trace shows B5/03, A0/D3, deceleration to zero, BF/03 and disconnect; no moving-belt A5/04 app request. App motor STOP remains unverified.
control_verification.speed: Physical rise from 1 to 2 km/h captured with no speed-setting write. Workout UI directs control through console. App speed-setting payload remains unknown.
control_verification.physical_key_events: An unsolicited B5/02 precedes A5/02 in the capture. Its meaning needs an operator-marked trace, not automatic forwarding based on a guessed interpretation.

manufacturer_context.finding: The manual describes app takeover of the console after Bluetooth connection. The current hosted revision names FitShow, unlike the captured iConsole variant; it does not verify this firmware byte protocol or which physical keys remain usable.

live_interlock: Remains in force while device/session/control behavior is verified.
implementation_scope: Application START/STOP/speed plus retained physical controls, with commands verified against this unit and explicit operator action.
